purpose: Tune both CQL and IQL on all6 existing MiniGridLoCA continuation cells.

algorithms.CQL: Existing discrete SAC-CQL with categorical soft backup and supported-action logsumexp penalty; unchanged baseline step.
algorithms.IQL: Existing target-Q expectile V, capped exponential advantage weighted categorical policy, Q regression to Task-B reward plus V, target update. Existing residual V parametrization retained.

search: Each fixed configuration runs to4096 on3 predetermined development seeds in everycell. Promote peralgorithm/cell union of top2 full-mean, top1 early-mean, top1 final and old plotted configuration; expand to all20 original paired seeds.
selection: Highest all20 mean normalized trapezoidal Task-B discounted return0..4096, tie early then final thenID. Same chosen configuration supplies all windows. Keep full candidate results; no ceiling relative to other methods; no seed filtering.
preserved: Fixed graphs, references, actor/critic initial parameters and optimizer moments, schedules, reward labels, batch128, gamma.99, evaluation grid, actor update count4096. Only recorded hyperparameters vary. No additional critic updates, altered data, BC warm-up or PDR value inputs.
reward: Every sampled record uses graph.reward_b. T1 reward4->1; T2 remains2. Old transition records receive current Task-B labels through the fixed table. No old reward in baseline targets.
metrics: Exact evaluator from original code: mean100-step discounted Task-B return over nonterminal states; T1/T2 arrivals supplementary. Early normalized trapezoidal mean0..1024, full0..4096, final4096.
initialization: Verify common full initial state and schedule/input hashes against archive; restore full native algorithm initialization before each configuration; change optimizer LR fields and target tau only as declared.
engineering: Full4096 old-config reproduction for one predetermined seed percell/method. IQL expectile and capped-weight gradient checks; CQL penalty algebra. Exact reward labels, serialization/restore equality and diagnostic invariance.
checkpoints: Complete native initialization,1024 and4096 checkpoints: model/target/optimizer/RNG plus recipe; no parameter-only substitutes. Saveprogress and stop under16GiB reserve.
parallelism: Up to24 workers on8GPUs (3 perGPU), balanced bounded recipe chunks. All floating-point/determinism settings inherited.

bootstrap.type: paired percentile bootstrap conditional on selected configuration

scope: All seeds are development seeds. Tuning outputs remain separate until reviewed; current main figures unchanged.
